name: scan-row-helper-local-to-git-e2e
body: The re-anchor fixture reads the single Scan row through a local db_scan_row helper that opens the database read-only, because recorded_scan is export-based and slated for deletion. The helper is private to this crate. Upgrade — promote it into apg::testutil if a second e2e crate needs the scanned_at column, and remove the export reader with its last caller.
